$comment: VAPP-85: THE source of the Exponential UI core catalog. Everything else is generated from it (core.schema.json, src/catalog.generated.ts, the Swift/Kotlin/Rust constants, docs/components.generated.json, fixtures/catalog-components.json). Canonical names = shadcn's; the A2UI basic catalog maps onto them (basic-map.json). `kind`: `native` = a renderer paints it, `macro` = macros.json expands it into natives before painting. `lite`: the core-lite subset (the app-shaped vocabulary: no overlays, media, Chart, data tables or the rarer controls) for small prompts. Round 3 (VAPP-102, docs/round-3-contract.md) folded the app vocabulary onto Row, Section, Chip, Segmented and Menu; round 4 (VAPP-103) REMOVED the old names: there are no aliases: an old name reduces to the `unknownComponent` placeholder with an `unknown component <name>` issue. `children`: none | one | many; `slots` = named child slots. Prop `type`: string | markdown | number | boolean | enum (`enum` names a shared list) | icon (an icons.json name) | color (a `$color.*` token ONLY: a literal `#hex`/`rgb()` in a node is refused so light and dark themes both apply; themes keep literals) | style (a Box style object) | array (`items`) | object (`shape` names a `defs` entry) | date (ISO yyyy-mm-dd) | url. `bindable` props take an A2UI data binding `{path}` or function call instead of a literal. Round 1 (docs/round-1-contract.md): `responsive` props ALSO take `{base, sm?, md?, lg?, xl?}` keyed by the `$breakpoint` token names (on a macro the expander turns them into `@media (min-width: $breakpoint.<bp>)` blocks; on a native the RENDERER picks the value of the active breakpoint, src/macros.ts responsiveAt + src/style.ts activeBreakpoint); EVERY component takes the common `visible` (a boolean or a binding; false = not rendered, no layout), `style` and `accessibility`; `slots: ["*"]` = any slot name (Table cell templates); a string default or value of the form `$string.<id>` is a built-in UI string (catalog/strings.json) the renderer shows in the surface locale; `object` props without a `shape` take any object. Descriptions are MODEL-FACING: one sentence, what and when. Variant/size LOOKS come from the theme's recipes (VAPP-92), never from here. EXP-1259 (the UI batch) adds the low-level feedback and search pieces the app settled on: `SearchList`, Spinner `xs`, Button `pendingLabel`, Skeleton rows, Tabs `closable`/`addable`, searchable Menu submenus. Round 8 (docs/round-8-contract.md): Canvas (a static vector drawing in Motion's shapes plus native `text`, always UPRIGHT: a text op takes only the translation and the uniform scale √|det| of fit × its transform, never a rotation or skew, so it looks the same on gpui; drawn through eui-motion's display list on every renderer; `pointer` press/move/leave in drawing units), Checkbox `indeterminate` (a dash, aria-checked mixed; a press checks it), Progress `valueText` + `detail`, Stepper `collapse` (`stepperCollapse`: never | auto | always; `auto` collapses below the `sm` breakpoint of the Stepper's own box through the new `@container` style condition). Round 9 (docs/round-9-contract.md, A2UI 1.0): `instructions` = the catalog rules as Markdown (the 1.0 catalog file's `instructions`); prop type `componentId` = a component id reference (Label.for, Popover.anchor, Menu.anchor); prop type `dynamic` = a binding or a call only, never a literal (a check's `condition`); optional component `parents: [names]` = the 1.0 `allowedParents` (`Surface` = only as root; none set); a function `returns` may be `validationResult` (the validators).
name: Exponential UI core
instructions:
Exponential UI core: shadcn-named components for app-shaped surfaces.

## Catalog rules

1. Components are flat: `{id, component, ...props}`. Exactly one has the id `root`. Ids are identifiers (letters, digits, `_`). `children` are ids (`["a", "b"]`), never inline components, or `{componentId, path, key?}`: one `componentId` per item of the array at `path` (`key` = the item field naming it). `slots` = `{name: id}`.
2. A dynamic prop takes a literal, a binding `{"@path": "/json/pointer"}` or a call `{"@call": "name", "args": {…}}`. Keep data in the data model and bind to it; a path without a leading `/` reads the current item.
3. `on: {<event>: action}`: an action is `{event: {name, context?, userMessage?}}` (sent to the agent) and/or `{functionCall: {"@call", args}}` (runs on the renderer: a catalog function, `set`, or a host function such as `app_toast`).
4. `visible: false` (or a binding) removes a component and its space. Inputs take `checks: [{condition, message?}]`; a condition is a binding or a call (`required`, `regex`, `length`, `numeric`, `email`).
5. Lay out with Page, Stack, Grid, Card, SplitView, Sidebar and List. A row of controls is a Toolbar, fields side by side a FieldGroup, the Cancel/submit row FormActions; Box + `style` only for the rest. Wrap fields in Form.
6. Prefer catalog components over Markdown, labels and tones over colours. A colour is a `$color.*` token, never `#hex`. Leave built-in copy (Cancel, Search…) unset: it is localized.
7. One default Button per screen (the submit or main action); the rest outline, secondary or ghost.

label.description: The text shown for the option.

value.description: The stable value the selection reports.

icon.description: An icon shown before the label.

disabled.description: Shows the option but refuses it.

count.description: A badge on a bar item.

condition.description: A binding or a function call that must hold (true, or a validation result) for the input to be valid.

message.description: The error shown when the condition fails.

value.description: The value reported when the tab is active.

count.description: A count badge after the title.

menuItem.description: One menu entry: an action, a checkbox, a separator, a group label or a submenu.

label.description: The entry text (a separator has none).

value.description: The value reported on select (actions and checkboxes).

shortcut.description: A key-cap hint after the text (`⌘K`).

checked.description: A checkbox entry's state; bind it.

destructive.description: Styles the entry as a destructive action.

disabled.description: Shows the entry greyed and inert.

items.description: A submenu's entries (one level deep); bind it to rows a host source feeds (statuses, members, labels).

searchable.description: Filters the submenu in a search list.

searchItem.description: One row of a search list.

identifier.description: A mono id before the title (`EXP-12`).

accordionItem.description: One collapsible section header; its body is the child at the same index.

value.description: The value reported when the section is open.

count.description: A count shown in the header.

field.description: With `rows`: the row field each value reads.

tone.description: The series' colour tone; charts default to the chart hues in order.

description.description: A muted line under the name.

type.description: How cells render: text, a locale number/currency/percent, a date, a relative time, a tick, a badge, or the named slot's component once per row.

slot.description: For `type: slot`: the Table slot whose component renders each cell with the row as its data scope.

width.description: A fixed width in px; otherwise columns share the width, never under 120 (a wider table scrolls).

sortable.description: Lets the header toggle the sort.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of a currency column (USD).

decimals.description: Fixed fraction digits of a number, currency or percent column.

truncate.description: One line with an ellipsis; cells wrap otherwise.

panel.description: One Resizable panel's limits, percent of the group.

collapsible.description: Drags to 0 below half its min; Enter on the handle toggles.

url.description: Where it was stored, for a preview link.

dateMark.description: An event dot on a day.

icon.description: The glyph (default: a folder or a file).

children.description: Child nodes; makes it a branch.

hasChildren.description: A branch whose children load on open (`load`).

functions.$comment: The core catalog exposes the A2UI basic catalog's 14 client-side functions, same names and arguments (vendor/a2ui/v0_9/basic_catalog.json#/functions; a basic surface calls them unchanged; the format* functions format in the SURFACE locale, docs/round-1-contract.md §4), plus the 15 CORE functions of round 1 (and round 4's `filter`) (`core` below: named args, what they return) so a macro whose input is a data binding expands into a value the renderer computes at bind time (docs/round-1-contract.md §1; the expander emits them, an author may call them too). Round 2 (docs/round-2-contract.md §3): `formatPercent` and `formatRelativeTime` join them, and EVERY format function (the basic formatNumber/formatCurrency/formatDate/pluralize too) runs through the surface's host-supplied Formatter (locale + timeZone from SurfaceSettings; the English fallback = Intl en-US). Truthiness everywhere = src/expr.ts `truthy`: undefined, null, false and "" are false, 0 is TRUE. Arguments are resolved at ANY depth (an array or object argument may hold bindings and calls). `basic` = the basic functions' signatures (vendor/a2ui, flattened) so the prompt lists every function with its arguments. `set` and `bind` are the two ACTION functions (`bind` = VAPP-122: `{path, source, params?}` re-follows a data model path from a binding source, see catalog/host.json `functions`); `set`: in an Action's `functionCall` it writes `value` to the data model at `path` (two-way binding for macros; an Action may carry `functionCall` AND `event`: every argument and the event context are evaluated FIRST, then the write, then the event). VAPP-191 (eApps Q2): the expression functions (mul div mod round floor ceil abs min max today now dateAdd dateDiff startOf endOf weekday isoWeek hours formatDuration) and `expr` (the CEL string form, {expr, vars}) are ONE table with the string form (src/cel.ts, fixtures/expressions.json): strict (a failed call has no value), dates in the surface (team) zone.

percent.description: The share of max as "N%", clamped to 0..100, two decimals; 0% when max is not positive.

eq.description: Strict equality of two values, except that a number equals a string spelling it (5 and "5"); nothing else coerces.

clamp.description: value as a number held inside [min, max]; a missing bound does not clamp; min wins when max < min.

fallback.description: value unless it is missing (undefined or null), else default; a template's `{x|default}` over a bound x.

concat.description: The values joined into one string (undefined and null as empty).

text.description: The value as a string; no value when it is missing.

map.description: cases[String(value)] when that case exists, else default.

len.description: An array's or a string's length, else 0.

fill.description: template with its {name} placeholders filled from params (unknown ones stay); a `$string.<id>` template resolves through the surface's string table first.

set.description: Action only: writes value into the data model at path (a JSON pointer, relative to the node's data scope like a binding).

formatPercent.description: A ratio as a locale percent through the surface Formatter (0.256 → 26%); decimals = fixed fraction digits.

formatRelativeTime.description: A date (yyyy-mm-dd, ISO date-time or epoch ms) relative to now (epoch ms or a date; default the clock) through the surface Formatter: 3 minutes ago, yesterday, in 2 hours.

filter.description: The items that match, in order: every `where` field equals its value (an empty value matches all) and `query` is a case-insensitive substring of one of `fields` (default every text field); bind a List or Table to it.

bind.description: Action only (VAPP-122): re-follows path from source with params appended as its query (sourceWithParams); the package's sources allowlist applies and the earlier subscription at that path is cancelled.

mul.description: a * b; numbers only (else no value).

div.description: a / b; no value when b is 0.

mod.description: a % b (sign of a); no value when b is 0.

round.description: Half away from zero, to digits (0..10, default 0).

today.description: Today (YYYY-MM-DD) in the team time zone.

dateTime.description: A day (YYYY-MM-DD) at a wall-clock time (HH:MM; none = midnight) in the team time zone, as an ISO instant.

dateAdd.description: date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO instant) plus n whole units (second minute hour day week month quarter year; a day keeps the local time; month ends clamp).

dateDiff.description: Whole units from a to b (b - a, truncated).

startOf.description: The first day (or instant) of date's day, week (Monday), month, quarter or year.

endOf.description: The last day (or instant) of that unit.

orElse.description: The value, or default when it is missing (null): narrows an optional value.

expr.description: Evaluates a CEL expression string (docs/package-format.md Expressions) over vars (name → value or binding): "round(entries.sum / 60, 1)"; default is shown when it fails (required in a package).

builtinIcons.$comment: Round 1: the glyph every renderer draws for a part it owns (`<Component>.<part>[.<variant>]` → an icons.json name, generated as builtinIconSlots/builtinIconNames), so a copy button, a drop zone or a sort arrow is the same icon on every platform. Append-only.

Box.description: A styled container laid out by the whitelisted style object; what every macro expands into. `on.hover` fires when the pointer enters it.

style.description: Layout and visual properties from the Box whitelist (flex, grid, sizes, spacing, colours).

pressable.description: Makes the box a press target that fires `press`.

Stack.description: A flex container that lays its children out in one direction with a gap.

direction.description: A row or a column (`{base: "vertical", md: "horizontal"}`).

align.description: Unset: `center` in a row, `stretch` in a column.

wrap.description: Lets children wrap onto new lines.

style.description: Extra Box styles merged over the stack's own.

Grid.description: An equal-column grid for cards and tiles.

style.description: Extra Box styles merged over the grid's own.

Card.description: A bordered card with an optional title and description, for grouped content, not page headers.

description.description: A muted line under the heading.

padded.description: Pads the body; off for edge-to-edge rows.

style.description: Extra Box styles merged over the card's own.

pressable.description: A press target firing `press` (an `on.press` implies it).

Window.description: A window frame: a chrome bar with three dots and an optional caption over one child that fills the body.

title.description: The centred caption in the chrome bar.

style.description: Extra Box styles merged over the window's own.

orientation.description: A horizontal rule or a vertical bar.

List.description: A windowed scrolling list for anything longer than a screen; children may come from a data template.

sectionBy.description: Groups consecutive items by this field; slot `section` = each header ({value, count}).

style.description: Extra Box styles for the list frame.

Resizable.description: Panels split by draggable handles; each child is one panel.

handle.description: Draws a grip on each handle.

style.description: Extra Box styles for the group box (give it a height).

ScrollArea.description: A scrolling region of bounded height or width.

maxHeight.description: Px it scrolls within; omit to fill the parent.

style.description: Extra Box styles merged over the region's own.

Sidebar.description: A shell: a nav column (`sidebar` slot) beside the children, hidden narrow or collapsed.

collapsed.description: Hides the column; bind it to a toggle.

SplitView.description: List (`list` slot) + detail (children); phones show one at a time, the detail with a back button.

open.description: On phones, the detail shows instead of the list; bind it to the open item.

width.description: The list column width in px.

AppBar.description: A top bar: title, optional subtitle and back button, `leading`/`trailing` slots.

subtitle.description: A muted line under the title.

back.description: Shows a back button that fires `back`.

Page.description: A screen: an AppBar row (back, title, trailing actions) over a padded scrolling body.

subtitle.description: A muted line under the title.

back.description: Shows a back button that fires `back`.

padded.description: Pads the body; off for edge-to-edge lists.

Toolbar.description: Controls in one row, bottoms aligned, wrapping on phones; `trailing` = the end action.

Section.description: A band header over hairline-divided rows: title, caption, count and glyph, foldable, tinted; no title = just the rows.

title.description: The band's label; omit it for a bare run of rows.

count.description: A count after the title; off unless given.

icon.description: A glyph before the title (the `leading` slot replaces it).

collapsible.description: The header folds the rows (chevron, press).

open.description: Whether the rows show; bind it.

tree.description: The rows form a tree: each `Row.depth` indents and draws its guides.

loading.description: A refetch is running: a small spinner before the count. The first load is a Skeleton instead.

style.description: Extra Box styles for the frame.

Group.description: A form-field container: a rounded group of rows with an optional title and footnote.

footer.description: A muted note under the group.

Text.description: A run of text in one of the type styles; prefer dedicated components over inline markdown.

lines.description: Truncates to this many lines with an ellipsis.

tone.description: A colour tone instead of the default foreground.

shimmer.description: Animates a highlight across the text while work runs.

style.description: Extra Box styles for the text box.

Heading.description: A section or page heading at one of four levels.

level.description: h1 is the page title, h4 the smallest.

profile.description: `inline` = a run of text (no outer block gap, paragraphs in the Text type of `variant`), `document` = full prose.

variant.description: The paragraph type of the inline profile.

lines.description: Truncates the rendered body to this many lines with an ellipsis.

style.description: Extra Box styles for the markdown box.

CodeBlock.description: Source code in a mono block: syntax colouring, optional line numbers, a copy button.

wrap.description: Wraps long lines instead of scrolling sideways.

maxLines.description: Lines shown before the block scrolls.

Kbd.description: A keyboard shortcut drawn as a key cap.

Label.description: A caption for a control that has no label of its own, with an optional required mark.

for.description: The id of the control it labels.

Image.description: A picture from a URL, or a placeholder box when it has none.

src.description: The image URL; omit for a placeholder.

fit.description: How the picture fills its box.

width.description: Fixed width in px; otherwise the box decides.

aspectRatio.description: Width over height (16:9 when unset and no height); the box never waits for the picture.

fallback.description: An icon shown when the picture fails or is missing.

loading.description: Defer loading until near the viewport, or load at once.

focalX.description: Horizontal focal point 0..1 kept when cropped (0.5).

focalY.description: Vertical focal point 0..1 kept when cropped (0.5).

style.description: Extra Box styles for the image box.

ZoomableImage.description: A picture that zooms (pinch, ⌘-wheel, double-tap) and pans.

style.description: Extra Box styles for the viewport.

Icon.description: One icon from the shared Lucide registry, by name.

name.description: The icon name (an icons.json concept or Lucide name).

tone.description: A colour tone instead of the current text colour.

label.description: An accessibility label when the icon stands alone.

Video.description: A video player: the poster until play, then the platform player with its controls.

src.description: The video URL (H.264 + AAC MP4 plays everywhere).

aspectRatio.description: Width over height of the player box.

style.description: Extra Box styles for the player box.

AudioPlayer.description: An audio player with a title and a play control.

Avatar.description: A round user picture that falls back to initials on a stable hue.

name.description: The person's name or email; initials come from it.

seed.description: A user id: hashes the fallback's palette hue; none = muted.

QrCode.description: A QR code of a value, dark on a light plate.

label.description: A caption under it and its accessibility label.

Carousel.description: A horizontally paging scroller; each child is one page.

loop.description: Wraps from the last page to the first.

Mosaic.description: Pictures: halves, or one large + two small with `+N`; press fires `select {index}`.

Tabs.description: Tab navigation; the child at index i is the panel of tab i.

value.description: The active tab's value; bind it for two-way state.

fill.description: Stretches the headers across the width.

Segmented.description: ONE row or column of segments: a pill track, toggles, joined outline buttons, a bottom bar or a rail.

value.description: The selected value (comma-joined when multiple); bind it.

variant.description: Pill track, bare toggles, joined outline buttons, or a full-width icon `bar`.

fill.description: Stretches the segments across the width (a `bar` always does).

Accordion.description: Collapsible sections; the child at index i is the body of item i.

type.description: One section open at a time, or any number.

value.description: The open section's value (comma-joined when multiple); bind it.

Collapsible.description: One disclosure section with a title row that shows or hides its children.

open.description: Whether the body shows; bind it.

count.description: A count shown in the header.

Trace.description: A column of TraceItem lines (an agent's steps).

TraceItem.description: One step line: icon, title, muted detail; may expand to show its children.

status.description: running shimmers, error tints, pending dims, done ticks, skipped strikes.

open.description: Whether the children show; bind it.

Plan.description: A plan card: steps to approve, then progress and Stop.

Pagination.description: Previous, next and the current page out of a total.

Breadcrumb.description: The path to the current page; every item but the last is a link firing `select`.

items.description: The path from the root to the current page.

Outline.description: Anchor rows under a caption, one active; press fires `select {id}`.

Stepper.description: Wizard progress: numbered steps, finished ones ticked.

current.description: The 0-based index of the active step.

collapse.description: One line "Step n of m · label"; auto when narrower than sm.

Dialog.description: A centred modal over the surface, opened by its trigger slot or by binding `open`.

description.description: A muted line under the heading.

open.description: Whether it shows; bind it to a boolean path.

dismissible.description: Closes on the backdrop or Escape.

Drawer.description: A panel sliding in from an edge (a bottom sheet on phones).

description.description: A muted line under the heading.

open.description: Whether it shows; bind it to a boolean path.

side.description: The edge it slides from; `{base: "bottom", md: "right"}` turns the phone sheet into a side panel on wide surfaces.

dismissible.description: Closes on the backdrop or Escape.

dragToDismiss.description: Lets a swipe toward its edge close it.

DockCard.description: A floating one-row card whose children open in a bottom sheet with a pinned footer.

title.description: The one line under the header.

meta.description: Muted text at the header's end.

tone.description: The glyph's and the label's tone.

open.description: Whether the sheet shows; bind it.

example.label: Plan ready
example.caption: Ask dock
example.title: Fold the composer into the Dock

AlertDialog.description: A modal that asks for a confirmation and ignores clicks outside; fires `confirm` or `cancel`.

destructive.description: Styles the confirming button as dangerous.

Popover.description: A small panel anchored to its trigger, opened on press.

anchor.description: A node id to open at; it toggles it.

openOn.description: Press, or hover over the trigger (press on touch).

Tooltip.description: A short hint shown on hover or long-press over its children.

Menu.description: A menu of actions, checkboxes, groups and submenus, opened by pressing its child or right-click / long-press.

label.description: The default trigger's text when no child is given.

anchor.description: A node id to open at; it toggles it.

openOn.description: A press on the child, or the context gesture over it.

Toast.description: A transient notice in the toast layer; render one per notice with `open` bound.

type.description: Severity: icon and tone (`error` interrupts readers).

open.description: Whether it shows; bind it so the host learns of a dismissal.

duration.description: Ms until it dismisses itself; 0 = never.

actionLabel.description: A button label; pressing it fires `action`.

Badge.description: A small count or status label.

Alert.description: An inline banner with an icon, a title and a message.

type.description: The severity, which picks the icon and tone.

Chip.description: A small token: a pill (filter, label, state) or a rect naming an entity with a glyph or image; removable.

shape.description: A rounded pill or a squarer entity chip.

selected.description: Draws it as the active choice.

dot.description: A colour dot before the text (a label chip).

image.description: A round picture instead of the icon.

removable.description: Shows a remove control that fires `remove`.

pressable.description: Makes it a press target that fires `press`.

EmptyState.description: What an empty screen or list says: a short title; `page` adds the icon disc, a sentence and an action, `list` one muted line.

icon.description: The glyph: in the disc on `page`, bare on `list`.

actionLabel.description: A button label, `page` only; pressing it fires `press`.

size.description: page = a whole screen's empty state with disc, sentence and action; list = one muted line under a bare glyph, no description, no action.

Progress.description: A horizontal progress bar with an optional label.

valueText.description: Text after the label (rate, time left).

Meter.description: A usage track: a bar of coloured segments against a maximum, with a caption and a value.

value.description: A formatted value after the track.

Ring.description: A circular progress ring for a fraction, sized like an icon.

size.description: Diameter class; `xs` = inline in a header.

Skeleton.description: A pulsing placeholder: a block, or `rows` rows.

width.description: A length (px or %); defaults to the full width.

height.description: A length (px); defaults to one text line.

rounded.description: A circle instead of a bar.

VoiceWave.description: A live voice level: three waves around an optional decorative child.

size.description: Edge class; sm hides the child.

CallSurface.description: A voice call screen: wave, avatar, name, status, caption, call buttons.

Table.description: Typed columns: sorting, selection, widths, alignment, windowed; `slot` columns render components.

rows.description: One object per row keyed by column key; bind it for live data.

rowKey.description: The row field that identifies a row.

sort.description: The active sort; bound = you order `rows`, unbound = sorted locally.

selected.description: The selected row keys; bind them.

emptyText.description: Shown when there are no rows.

stickyHeader.description: Pins the header while rows scroll.

Chart.description: A bar, stacked-bar, line, area, pie, donut or sparkline chart with axes, legend and tooltip.

categories.description: The x-axis labels, or the pie slices; omit for a sparkline.

series.description: One per line, bar group or pie ring.

height.description: The whole chart's height in px (title, legend, axes inside); the width is the box's.

xLabel.description: A caption under the x axis.

yLabel.description: A caption beside the y axis.

max.description: The y-axis ceiling; defaults to the largest value.

valueFormat.description: Ticks, tooltip and values; percent takes ratios.

showAxes.description: Draws the axes with tick labels.

showGrid.description: Draws horizontal grid lines at the ticks.

showLegend.description: Draws the legend (2+ series or slices).

showValues.description: Writes each value on its bar, point or slice.

Sparkline.description: A tiny inline trend line of recent values, no axes or legend.

StatTile.description: A dashboard tile: label, big value, toned change, trend sparkline.

pressable.description: A press target firing `press` (an `on.press` implies it).

Button.description: A press target with a label and optional icon (or one custom child).

label.description: The button text (omit for an icon-only button).

icon.description: An icon before the label, or alone with size `icon`.

href.description: The URL a press opens; `press` still fires.

size.description: Control height class; `icon` is a square icon-only button.

checks.description: Validation rules: a failing `error` disables it (warning and info never do).

loading.description: Pending: refuses presses, then shows a spinner.

submit.description: Submits the enclosing Form on press.

Link.description: Inline link text that opens a URL or fires `press`.

href.description: The URL to open; omit to handle `press` yourself.

external.description: Marks it as leaving the app.

Toggle.description: A two-state button that stays pressed.

label.description: The button text or accessibility label.

icon.description: An icon before or instead of the label.

Form.description: Collects its fields by `name` and fires `submit` with their values once every check passes.

name.description: The form's key in the submit payload.

busy.description: Shows the submit pending and refuses another submit.

summary.description: Also lists every failed check above the fields.

FieldGroup.description: Fields side by side (Starts / Ends) that stack on phones.

FormActions.description: The end-aligned button row: children, Cancel, then THE submit (the one primary).

SettingsRow.description: A settings line: label (+ description) at the start, the control (children) at the end; stacks on phones.

description.description: A muted line under the label.

stackBelow.description: Puts the control under the label below this breakpoint.

name.description: The field's key in the submitted data.

value.description: The text; bind it to a data path.

checks.description: Validation rules (required, email, length, regex, numeric).

name.description: The field's key in the submitted data.

autosize.description: Grows with the text from `rows` up to `maxRows`.

maxRows.description: Autosize stops growing here and scrolls.

value.description: The text; bind it to a data path.

NumberField.description: A numeric field with steppers, min/max/step clamping and locale formatting.

name.description: The field's key in the submitted data.

step.description: What the steppers and arrow keys add; Shift multiplies by 10.

precision.description: Decimal places shown; defaults to the step's.

name.description: The field's key in the submitted data.

indeterminate.description: Mixed: a dash; a press checks it.

Radio.description: A labelled group of radio options choosing one value; bind `value`.

name.description: The field's key in the submitted data.

ChoiceTiles.description: Picture tiles picking one or many values; options show `image` and `description`.

name.description: The field's key in the submitted data.

value.description: The pick (comma-joined when multiple); bind it.

name.description: The field's key in the submitted data.

description.description: A muted line under the label.

Slider.description: A slider from min to max.

Rating.description: A row of stars scoring out of `max`; `readOnly` only displays.

Select.description: A dropdown picker of one or many options; `searchable` = a filtering combobox, `source` = a host list.

name.description: The field's key in the submitted data.

options.description: Inline choices, or a path the host refills on `search`; omit with `source`.

source.description: A host list id (e.g. `exp:statuses`) that supplies the options.

value.description: The chosen value (comma-joined when multiple); bind it.

searchable.description: Adds a filter field; typing fires `search`.

emptyText.description: Shown when the search matches nothing.

SearchList.description: A search field over rows: typing filters, arrows move, Enter picks.

ChipInput.description: A multi-value field of removable chips (Enter or comma adds); bind `values`.

name.description: The field's key in the submitted data.
The field's key in the submitted data.

value.description: The chosen day as yyyy-mm-dd, or empty.

inline.description: The month grid in place, no field.

today.description: The ringed day; else the host's.

DateRangePicker.description: A two-date range field with one calendar (ISO dates).

name.description: The field's key in the submitted data (`{start, end}`).

start.description: The first day as yyyy-mm-dd, or empty.

end.description: The last day as yyyy-mm-dd, or empty.

TimePicker.description: A time-of-day field (`HH:mm`) picked from a list every `step` minutes, or typed.

name.description: The field's key in the submitted data.

FileUpload.description: A drop zone with a browse button; files reach the host via `upload`, listed back in `files`.

name.description: The field's key in the submitted data.

maxSize.description: Max bytes per file; bigger ones are refused.

hint.description: Text under the drop zone's title.

QrScanner.description: A QR scanner viewfinder; the host camera fires `scanned {value}`.

example.hint: Point at the code on your computer

Composer.description: The chat input box: a growing text field with a submit button and optional attachments.

busy.description: Turns submit into a stop while a reply streams.

Row.description: THE list row: a lead glyph or slot, a mono identifier, title and subtitle, trailing meta or value, a slot and a chevron; flat or card, nestable; with children a foldable parent.

identifier.description: A mono identifier before the title (`EXP-12`).

meta.description: Trailing muted text (a count, a time).

value.description: A trailing readable value (a property, a pick).

placeholder.description: Muted trailing text while `value` is empty.

icon.description: The lead glyph (the `leading` slot replaces it).

selected.description: Draws it as the active row.

surface.description: A flat row, or a padded card with its own fill and border.

pressable.description: Makes it a press target that fires `press` (an `on.press` implies it).

href.description: The URL a press opens; implies `pressable`.

depth.description: Depth under a tree Section (0 = root).

open.description: With children: whether they show, indented; bind it.

Tree.description: A file-style tree: branches fold, leaves select, lazy branches load; keyboard per WAI-ARIA.

expanded.description: The open branch ids; bind it.

MessageBubble.description: A chat message bubble, in (left, after an avatar) or out (right).

pressable.description: A press target firing `press` (`on.press` or `href` imply it).

href.description: The URL a press opens; implies `pressable`.

TreeGuides.description: The tree gutter a nested Row draws (filled by the core); never authored directly.

elbowAt.description: The gutter index that draws the elbow into this row; omit for a root.

tee.description: Continues the line past this row to a later sibling.

passThrough.description: Gutter indexes whose ancestor line continues straight through.

Unknown.description: A renderer's placeholder for an undefined component; never authored directly.

catalogId.description: The catalog the component was authored against.

Motion.description: A vector animation (Lottie-compatible) drawn identically everywhere: loaders, success states, illustrated empty states, small explainers.

layers.description: The animation, top layer first, in the composition's px (origin top-left). Layer: {type: shape|solid|null|precomp|text, id?, parent?: id, in?/out? ms, transform?: {anchor, position [x,y], scale [100,100] %, rotation deg clockwise, opacity 0–100}, shapes: […], matte?: {source: id, mode: alpha|luma}, masks?: [{path, mode: add|subtract|intersect}]}. Shapes draw top first; a style paints every shape before it in its group: rect {position (centre), size, radius}, ellipse {position, size}, star|polygon {points, outerRadius, innerRadius}, path {d: SVG path data}; fill {color}, stroke {color, width, cap, join, dash: [len, gap]}, gradient-fill {kind: linear|radial, start, end, stops: [[0, colour], [1, colour]]}; trim {start, end, offset} (percent, draw-on lines), repeater {copies, transform}, round-corners {radius}; group {shapes, transform}. Colours: $color.* tokens (follow light/dark), #hex, or {light, dark}. Animate any value: {keys: [{t: ms, v: value, ease: linear|ease-in|ease-out|ease-in-out|hold|[x1,y1,x2,y2]}, …]}; tokens cannot animate. Keep it small; loops end on their first pose. No expressions.

lottie.description: Lottie JSON instead of layers (no expressions).

src.description: An attached .json or .lottie instead of layers.

autoplay.description: Plays when visible; false shows the poster.

loop.description: Repeats; false plays once and holds.

direction.description: Forward, reverse, or back and forth.

poster.description: The still frame (ms) for reduced motion and before play.

stateMachine.description: A dotLottie state machine driving playback (a .lottie src brings its own).

inputs.description: State-machine inputs {name: value}; bind to drive states from data.

label.description: What it shows, for screen readers.

style.description: Extra Box styles for the box.

Canvas.description: A static drawing (chart, diagram, illustration) of shapes and text; Motion animates.

shapes.description: Motion's shapes, no keys, + text {text, position, size, weight, align start|center|end, baseline top|middle|alphabetic, font sans|mono, color} on top, always upright.

label.description: What it shows, for screen readers.

pointer.description: press/move/leave get {x, y} in drawing units.

style.description: Extra Box styles for the box.

Calendar.description: A month or week of records: spans as chart-coloured bars in lanes; on phones dots and the day's agenda.

source.description: Where a records `by` binding lands (reads `month` or `week`).

labelField.description: The row field a bar shows.

Timeline.description: Records over time: rows of chart-coloured bars across week, month or quarter columns.

labelField.description: The row field a bar shows.

showCount.description: Each row's count under its label.

RecordForm.description: A form over one record kind: a field per schema field with its checks; submit saves the record.

recordId.description: The record to update; none = a new record.

readOnly.description: Shows the fields inert, no submit.

path.description: The draft's data path (default /recordForm/<id>); seed it to edit.

RecordTable.description: One kind's records: count + Add, a sortable table (phones: a list), drawer edit, confirmed delete.

query.description: The records query (`sort=name&order=asc`, `query=<name>`); default newest first.

editable.description: Rows open the form; Edit and Delete show.
